events.verdict: Aminu (POR) clears the lane within three seconds.
Lillard (POR) makes contact with Harden's (HOU) shooting arm during his driving shot attempt.
Harden (HOU) makes incidental body contact with Lillard (POR) that does not affect his driving shot attempt.
Ariza (HOU) sets the screen on Turner (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Turner (POR) grabs and pulls Harden's (HOU) shorts away from his body and the contact affects his SQBR.
[Observable in enhanced video] Lillard (POR) slides his pivot foot at the end of his drive.
Ariza (HOU) and Turner (POR) engage and separate during the rebound.
Lillard (POR) cleanly steals the ball before making incidental body contact with Paul (HOU).
After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the foul by Harden (HOU) did not meet the criteria for a clear path foul and a common foul is assessed.
Harden (HOU) makes body to body contact with Lillard (POR) that affects his SQBR.
Gordon (HOU) makes incidental "high-five" contact with McCollum (POR) after the release of his jump shot attempt.
Tucker (HOU) firms up and sets the screen on Turner (POR) and gives him room to avoid the contact.
Aminu (POR) reaches in and makes body contact with Harden (HOU) that affects his ability to maintain control of the ball.
Ariza (HOU) legally contests Lillard's (POR) jump shot attempt.
Turner (POR) commits a take foul on Paul (HOU).
McCollum (POR) does not fully bring his hand underneath the ball and bring it to a pause.
McCollum (POR) commits a take foul on Paul (HOU).
Paul (HOU) legally contests McCollum's (POR) shot attempt.
